description: The head of a generated XML document: its version, root element name, stylesheets and attributes.
Used by the clients' `-xml` output. See `sge_cull_xml.cc`.

attributes.name: Version
description: The version string written into the XML declaration.

attributes.name: Name
description: Name of the document's root element.

attributes.name: Stylesheet
description: Stylesheet processing instructions (`XMLS_Type`) emitted before the root element.

attributes.name: Attribute
description: Attributes (`XMLA_Type`) placed on the root element, such as the schema location.
